structured_output.rationale: All three lines denied CO-16 with claim-level MOA N286 (missing/invalid referring provider primary identifier) — a data-defect denial, not coverage or medical-necessity. The 835 shows the claim was adjudicated (status 4 denied, CLP07 control number 2625180081827 present, 277CA accepted for processing), so per reference 00/09 this is an adjudicated clerical-error case, not an unprocessable/RUC one — fix is a reopening correcting the referring provider identifier, not an appeal or patient bill (group CO).

root_cause.explanation: CO-16 + N286 on all lines: the ordering/referring provider identifier is missing or invalid on the submitted claim; no referring-provider loop appears in the 837P at all.

next_action.detail: Add the ordering/referring provider name and NPI (verified against NPI Registry/PECOS) and rework via a Medicare Part B clerical-error reopening — the claim was adjudicated (CLP07 present, 277CA accepted), so use a reopening, not a new original claim or frequency-7 replacement, which Part B rejects.
